post.description:
Queued jobs become `canceled`; running jobs get `cancel_requested` (the worker kills the child); 409 when
the job is terminal.

get.description: 302 to a presigned URL (S3) or the bytes with `Range` support (local store).

post.description: `qt.api_key_created` (the secret appears only in this response).

delete.description: Revocation is immediate; unknown or already revoked keys are 404.

post.description: `ReportSpec` whose `inputs` are ids of succeeded jobs of this tenant.

get.description: `{id, job_id, files}` (files once the job succeeded).

put.description: Sets the tenant's retention (1..365 days each); audited.

get.description: `qt.page` of tombstones (ids, counts, sha256s, time; no data).

post.description: `qt.upload` with presigned part URLs (TTL <= 15 min; refresh with GET while pending).

delete.description: Hard delete (objects and row) with a tombstone.

post.description: Assembles the parts; status `complete` (sha256 verification follows asynchronously).
